I work across brand and product, so how something looks and how it works come from the same place.

I’m Leo Battiste, a product designer based in Florida. I like owning a product from the first idea to the shipped code, because the decisions that matter most tend to fall between disciplines.

Pheelm is the clearest example. It started as a name, became a logo and an identity, and then a product I designed and built myself.

I’m also a collector. The toolbox holds the tools and references I’ve saved over the years, shared in case they’re useful to you too.
